title: Ep 004 – Jim Thompson
guest_bio: Journalist and media leader turned storytelling coach for small businesses (BrightTrail; host of The Great Unfamous). Former chief audience officer at Billboard/Hollywood Reporter and part of Gary Vaynerchuk's personal-brand team.
summary: Journalist-turned-storyteller Jim Thompson on selling as service, telling stories with numbers, lessons from Gary Vaynerchuk's team, and why trust — built through story — is what unlocks word of mouth.
note: Chapter/quote timestamps are approximate — offset from the combined multi-episode Descript export. Re-export this episode individually for exact times.

chapters.title: Meeting at WorldNow: a journalist's path
Selling as service, not a pitch
The collaborative leader: 'let's back up a step'
When sales became a science: data meets the human
Inside Billboard: the Hot 100 A/B test
The Great Unfamous: give people their flowers now
Today: storytelling that builds trust & unlocks word of mouth

pull_quotes.speaker: Jim Thompson
pull_quotes.text: I didn't understand what selling was until I met you — that it could be a service, not a pitch.

pull_quotes.speaker: Jim Thompson
pull_quotes.text: My favorite phrase is, 'Hey, let's back up a step.'

pull_quotes.speaker: Jim Thompson
pull_quotes.text: People appreciate it when you talk to them like a peer, not like a teacher.

pull_quotes.speaker: Jim Thompson
pull_quotes.text: I just started telling stories with numbers. Why does this number matter?

pull_quotes.speaker: Jim Thompson
pull_quotes.text: For anyone to move forward, you gotta check a logic box and an emotion box.

pull_quotes.speaker: George Leith
pull_quotes.text: I've got a line — it's called Own Your Shit. If you make a mistake, own it.

pull_quotes.speaker: Jim Thompson
pull_quotes.text: They didn't care that Justin Bieber was number one. They wanted the song that jumped from 47 to 19.

pull_quotes.speaker: Jim Thompson
pull_quotes.text: Give those people their flowers while they're alive.

pull_quotes.speaker: Jim Thompson
pull_quotes.text: Very few people actually focus on you when they talk to you.

pull_quotes.speaker: Jim Thompson
pull_quotes.text: I love telling stories. It's what I'd do every day, all day if I didn't get paid.

pull_quotes.speaker: Jim Thompson
pull_quotes.text: What unlocks word of mouth is trust — and storytelling builds trust.

pull_quotes.speaker: George Leith
pull_quotes.text: You'd better start getting good at reinvention, because this train isn't stopping.
